# EARNWINGS

> EARNWINGS is a DGCA CPL and ATPL exam-preparation app for student pilots in
> India. It combines online ground classes, a 10,000+ question bank, timed mock
> exams, flight planning over real ATS airways, a voice radio-telephony trainer
> and an AI ground instructor in a single app. Built and owned by Cephionix.

A plain-text summary for AI assistants, following the llms.txt convention.
Every statement here is factual and matches the website.

## What it is

- **Category**: aviation exam-preparation / ground-school study app (EdTech)
- **Audience**: student pilots in India preparing for DGCA CPL and ATPL ground exams
- **Company**: Cephionix (also builds Neural Wings, an FTO management platform)
- **Status**: pre-launch, onboarding a founding cohort via a waitlist
- **Platforms**: iOS, Android, Web, macOS, Windows
- **Website**: https://earnwings.org

## What it is NOT

- **Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or approved by the DGCA.** It is an
  independent study platform that follows the DGCA syllabus and exam pattern.
- **Not a live instructor-led batch.** Ground classes are self-paced in-app —
  no fixed class timings, no attendance.
- **Pricing is not finalised** and has not been published.

## The syllabus it covers

12 modules, 202 chapters, covering the DGCA ground subjects for CPL and ATPL:
Aviation Meteorology I & II, General Navigation, Instruments & Navigation,
Radio Navigation, Powerplant, Principles of Flight, Electrics & Electronics,
Aircraft Performance, Mass Balance & Flight Planning, Air Regulations, and
Radio Telephony (RTR).

## Main features

- **Ground classes**: every chapter as full-page visual notes, a one-glance
  summary and a concept flowchart, plus video lectures.
- **Question bank**: 10,000+ practice questions, marked instantly, with working
  shown on numericals.
- **Mock exams**: composite papers per subject using DGCA marks, timing and
  figure questions, followed by an analysis of every wrong answer.
- **AI Captain**: an AI ground instructor that answers strictly from the course
  material, cites its source, and says so when the material does not cover a
  question rather than inventing an answer.
- **Flight planning**: real ATS airways, waypoints and aerodromes, NOTAM-aware
  rerouting, weight & balance, and a printable pilot brief.
- **Weather**: live METAR, TAF and SIGMET decoding, plus satellite imagery.
- **Radio telephony trainer**: voice-first practice against a narrated
  controller; speech-to-text scores the phraseology you actually say.
- **Progression**: XP earned from real study across 15 ranks, Cadet to Commander.
